   109→	_ = full

   113→	if sessionID != "" && commitRef != "" {

   115→	}

   132→// runExplainDefault explains the current branch state.
   133→// Shows branch-level information with checkpoint listing.
   134→// The verbose, full, and generate parameters control output detail level.
   135→func runExplainDefault(w io.Writer, noPager, verbose, full, generate bool, limit int) error {
   136→	// Silence unused variable warnings until generate is implemented
   137→	_ = generate
   138→
   139→	// Get current branch info
   140→	isDefault, branchName, err := IsOnDefaultBranch()
   141→	if err != nil {
   142→		branchName = "unknown"
   143→	}
   144→
   145→	// Apply default limit on main branch when limit is 0 (auto)
   146→	effectiveLimit := limit
   147→	if isDefault && limit == 0 {
   148→		effectiveLimit = defaultLimitOnMain
   149→	}
   150→
   151→	strat := GetStrategy()
   152→
   153→	// Get all rewind points (pass 0 for no limit at strategy level)
   154→	allPoints, err := strat.GetRewindPoints(0)
   155→	if err != nil {
   156→		// If no rewind points available, show empty branch view
   157→		allPoints = nil
   158→	}
   159→
   160→	totalCount := len(allPoints)
   161→
   162→	// Apply limit
   163→	points := allPoints
   164→	if effectiveLimit > 0 && len(points) > effectiveLimit {
   165→		points = points[:effectiveLimit]
   166→	}
   167→
   168→	// Load metadata for each checkpoint
   169→	checkpoints := make([]checkpointWithMeta, len(points))
   170→	for i, point := range points {

   172→			Point:    point,
   173→			Metadata: loadCheckpointMetadata(point.CheckpointID),
   174→		}
   175→	}
   176→
   177→	// Format output
   178→	output := formatBranchExplain(branchName, checkpoints, verbose, full, isDefault, effectiveLimit, totalCount)
   179→
   180→	if noPager {
   181→		fmt.Fprint(w, output)
   182→	} else {
   183→		outputWithPager(w, output)
   184→	}
   185→
   186→	return nil

   189→// formatBranchExplain formats the branch-level explain output.
   190→// Parameters:
   191→//   - branchName: the current branch name
   192→//   - checkpoints: the checkpoints with metadata to display (already limited)
   193→//   - verbose: show additional details like session IDs
   194→//   - full: show complete transcript (future use)
   195→//   - isDefault: whether on main/master branch
   196→//   - limit: the applied limit (0 means no limit)
   197→//   - totalCount: total number of checkpoints before limiting
   198→func formatBranchExplain(branchName string, checkpoints []checkpointWithMeta, verbose, full bool, isDefault bool, limit, totalCount int) string {
   199→	// Silence unused parameter warnings until full is implemented
   200→	_ = full
   201→
   202→	var sb strings.Builder
   203→
   204→	// Header
   205→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Branch: %s\n", branchName))
   206→	if isDefault && limit > 0 && totalCount > limit {
   207→		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Checkpoints: %d (showing last %d)\n", totalCount, limit))
   208→	} else {
   209→		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Checkpoints: %d\n", len(checkpoints)))
   210→	}
   211→
   212→	sb.WriteString("\n")
   213→
   214→	// Branch-level intent/outcome placeholders
   215→	sb.WriteString("Intent: (run with --generate to create summary)\n")
   216→	sb.WriteString("Outcome: (run with --generate to create summary)\n")
   217→
   218→	sb.WriteString("\n")
   219→	sb.WriteString(strings.Repeat("\u2500", 40)) // Unicode box drawing character for line
   220→	sb.WriteString("\n\n")
   221→
   222→	// Checkpoint details
   223→	for _, cp := range checkpoints {
   224→		point := cp.Point
   225→		meta := cp.Metadata
   226→
   227→		id := point.CheckpointID
   228→		if len(id) > 12 {
   229→			id = id[:12]
   230→		}
   231→		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("[%s] %s\n", id, point.Date.Format("2006-01-02 15:04")))
   232→
   233→		if verbose && point.SessionID != "" {
   234→			sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  Session: %s\n", point.SessionID))
   235→		}
   236→
   237→		// Display intent - real value if available, otherwise placeholder
   238→		intent := "(not generated)"
   239→		if meta != nil && meta.Intent != "" {
   240→			intent = meta.Intent
   241→		}
   242→		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  Intent: %s\n", intent))
   243→
   244→		// Display outcome - real value if available, otherwise placeholder
   245→		outcome := "(not generated)"
   246→		if meta != nil && meta.Outcome != "" {
   247→			outcome = meta.Outcome
   248→		}
   249→		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  Outcome: %s\n", outcome))
   250→
   251→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   252→	}
   253→
   254→	// Footer for limited view
   255→	if isDefault && limit > 0 && totalCount > limit {
   256→		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("(%d total checkpoints. Use --limit N to adjust)\n", totalCount))
   257→	}
   258→
   259→	return sb.String()
   260→}

   262→// runExplainSession explains a specific session.
   263→func runExplainSession(w io.Writer, sessionID string, noPager bool) error {
   264→	strat := GetStrategy()
   265→
   266→	// Get session details
   267→	session, err := strategy.GetSession(sessionID)
   268→	if err != nil {
   269→		if errors.Is(err, strategy.ErrNoSession) {
   270→			return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   271→		}
   272→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get session: %w", err)
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	// Get source ref (metadata branch + commit) for this session
   276→	sourceRef := strat.GetSessionMetadataRef(session.ID)
   277→
   278→	// Gather checkpoint details
   279→	checkpointDetails := gatherCheckpointDetails(strat, session)
   280→
   281→	// For strategies like shadow where active sessions may not have checkpoints,
   282→	// try to get the current session transcript directly
   283→	if len(checkpointDetails) == 0 && len(session.Checkpoints) == 0 {
   284→		checkpointDetails = gatherCurrentSessionDetails(strat, session)
   285→	}
   286→
   287→	// Format output
   288→	output := formatSessionInfo(session, sourceRef, checkpointDetails)
   289→
   290→	// Output with pager if appropriate
   291→	if noPager {
   292→		fmt.Fprint(w, output)
   293→	} else {
   294→		outputWithPager(w, output)
   295→	}
   296→
   297→	return nil
   298→}

   300→// gatherCurrentSessionDetails attempts to get transcript info for sessions without checkpoints.
   301→// This handles strategies like shadow where active sessions may not have checkpoint commits.
   302→func gatherCurrentSessionDetails(strat strategy.Strategy, session *strategy.Session) []checkpointDetail {
   303→	// Try to get transcript via GetSessionContext which reads from metadata branch
   304→	// For shadow, we can read the transcript from the same location pattern
   305→	contextContent := strat.GetSessionContext(session.ID)
   306→	if contextContent == "" {
   307→		return nil
   308→	}
   309→
   310→	// Parse the context.md to extract the last prompt/summary
   311→	// Context.md typically has sections like "# Prompt\n...\n## Summary\n..."
   312→	detail := checkpointDetail{
   313→		Index:     1,
   314→		Timestamp: session.StartTime,
   315→		Message:   "Current session",
   316→	}
   317→
   318→	// Try to extract prompt and summary from context.md
   319→	lines := strings.Split(contextContent, "\n")
   320→	var inPrompt, inSummary bool
   321→	var promptLines, summaryLines []string
   322→
   323→	for _, line := range lines {
   324→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   325→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "# ") && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "prompt") {
   326→			inPrompt = true
   327→			inSummary = false
   328→			continue
   329→		}
   330→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "## ") && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "summary") {
   331→			inPrompt = false
   332→			inSummary = true
   333→			continue
   334→		}
   335→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "## ") || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "# ") {
   336→			inPrompt = false
   337→			inSummary = false
   338→			continue
   339→		}
   340→
   341→		if inPrompt {
   342→			promptLines = append(promptLines, line)
   343→		} else if inSummary {
   344→			summaryLines = append(summaryLines, line)
   345→		}
   346→	}
   347→
   348→	var inter interaction
   349→	if len(promptLines) > 0 {
   350→		inter.Prompt = strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(promptLines, "\n"))
   351→	}
   352→	if len(summaryLines) > 0 {
   353→		inter.Responses = []string{strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(summaryLines, "\n"))}
   354→	}
   355→
   356→	// If we couldn't parse structured content, show the raw context
   357→	if inter.Prompt == "" && len(inter.Responses) == 0 {
   358→		inter.Responses = []string{contextContent}
   359→	}
   360→
   361→	if inter.Prompt != "" || len(inter.Responses) > 0 {
   362→		detail.Interactions = []interaction{inter}
   363→	}
   364→
   365→	return []checkpointDetail{detail}
   366→}

   368→// gatherCheckpointDetails extracts detailed information for each checkpoint.
   369→// Checkpoints come in newest-first order, but we number them oldest=1, newest=N.
   370→func gatherCheckpointDetails(strat strategy.Strategy, session *strategy.Session) []checkpointDetail {
   371→	details := make([]checkpointDetail, 0, len(session.Checkpoints))
   372→	total := len(session.Checkpoints)
   373→
   374→	for i, cp := range session.Checkpoints {
   375→		detail := checkpointDetail{
   376→			Index:            total - i, // Reverse numbering: oldest=1, newest=N
   377→			Timestamp:        cp.Timestamp,
   378→			IsTaskCheckpoint: cp.IsTaskCheckpoint,
   379→			Message:          cp.Message,
   380→		}
   381→
   382→		// Use checkpoint ID for display (truncate long IDs)
   383→		detail.ShortID = cp.CheckpointID
   384→		if len(detail.ShortID) > 12 {
   385→			detail.ShortID = detail.ShortID[:12]
   386→		}
   387→
   388→		// Try to get transcript for this checkpoint
   389→		transcriptContent, err := strat.GetCheckpointLog(cp)
   390→		if err == nil {
   391→			transcript, parseErr := parseTranscriptFromBytes(transcriptContent)
   392→			if parseErr == nil {
   393→				// Extract all prompt/response pairs from the transcript
   394→				pairs := ExtractAllPromptResponses(transcript)
   395→				for _, pair := range pairs {
   396→					detail.Interactions = append(detail.Interactions, interaction(pair))
   397→				}
   398→
   399→				// Aggregate all files for the checkpoint
   400→				fileSet := make(map[string]bool)
   401→				for _, pair := range pairs {
   402→					for _, f := range pair.Files {
   403→						if !fileSet[f] {
   404→							fileSet[f] = true
   405→							detail.Files = append(detail.Files, f)
   406→						}
   407→					}
   408→				}
   409→			}
   410→		}
   411→
   412→		details = append(details, detail)
   413→	}
   414→
   415→	return details
   416→}

   418→// runExplainCommit explains a specific commit.
   419→func runExplainCommit(w io.Writer, commitRef string) error {
   420→	repo, err := openRepository()
   421→	if err != nil {
   422→		return fmt.Errorf("not a git repository: %w", err)
   423→	}
   424→
   425→	// Resolve the commit reference
   426→	hash, err := repo.ResolveRevision(plumbing.Revision(commitRef))
   427→	if err != nil {
   428→		return fmt.Errorf("commit not found: %s", commitRef)
   429→	}
   430→
   431→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(*hash)
   432→	if err != nil {
   433→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
   434→	}
   435→
   436→	// Get files changed in this commit (diff from parent to current)
   437→	var files []string
   438→	commitTree, err := commit.Tree()
   439→	if err == nil && commit.NumParents() > 0 {
   440→		parent, parentErr := commit.Parent(0)
   441→		if parentErr == nil {
   442→			parentTree, treeErr := parent.Tree()
   443→			if treeErr == nil {
   444→				// Diff from parent to current commit to show what changed
   445→				changes, diffErr := parentTree.Diff(commitTree)
   446→				if diffErr == nil {
   447→					for _, change := range changes {
   448→						name := change.To.Name
   449→						if name == "" {
   450→							name = change.From.Name
   451→						}
   452→						files = append(files, name)
   453→					}
   454→				}
   455→			}
   456→		}
   457→	}
   458→
   459→	// Check for Entire metadata
   460→	metadataDir, hasMetadata := paths.ParseMetadataTrailer(commit.Message)
   461→	sessionID, hasSession := paths.ParseSessionTrailer(commit.Message)
   462→
   463→	// If no session trailer, try to extract from metadata path.
   464→	// Note: extractSessionIDFromMetadata is defined in rewind.go as it's used
   465→	// by both the rewind and explain commands for parsing metadata paths.
   466→	if !hasSession && hasMetadata {
   467→		sessionID = extractSessionIDFromMetadata(metadataDir)
   468→		hasSession = sessionID != ""
   469→	}
   470→
   471→	// Build commit info
   472→	fullSHA := hash.String()
   473→	shortSHA := fullSHA
   474→	if len(fullSHA) >= 7 {
   475→		shortSHA = fullSHA[:7]
   476→	}
   477→
   478→	info := &commitInfo{
   479→		SHA:       fullSHA,
   480→		ShortSHA:  shortSHA,
   481→		Message:   strings.Split(commit.Message, "\n")[0], // First line only
   482→		Author:    commit.Author.Name,
   483→		Email:     commit.Author.Email,
   484→		Date:      commit.Author.When,
   485→		Files:     files,
   486→		HasEntire: hasMetadata || hasSession,
   487→		SessionID: sessionID,
   488→	}
   489→
   490→	// Format and output
   491→	output := formatCommitInfo(info)
   492→	fmt.Fprint(w, output)
   493→
   494→	return nil
   495→}

   497→// formatSessionInfo formats session information for display.
   498→func formatSessionInfo(session *strategy.Session, sourceRef string, checkpoints []checkpointDetail) string {
   499→	var sb strings.Builder
   500→
   501→	// Session header
   502→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Session: %s\n", session.ID))
   503→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Strategy: %s\n", session.Strategy))
   504→
   505→	if !session.StartTime.IsZero() {
   506→		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Started: %s\n", session.StartTime.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")))
   507→	}
   508→
   509→	if sourceRef != "" {
   510→		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Source Ref: %s\n", sourceRef))
   511→	}
   512→
   513→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Checkpoints: %d\n", len(checkpoints)))
   514→
   515→	// Checkpoint details
   516→	for _, cp := range checkpoints {
   517→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   518→
   519→		// Checkpoint header
   520→		taskMarker := ""
   521→		if cp.IsTaskCheckpoint {
   522→			taskMarker = " [Task]"
   523→		}
   524→		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("─── Checkpoint %d [%s] %s%s ───\n",
   525→			cp.Index, cp.ShortID, cp.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02 15:04"), taskMarker))
   526→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   527→
   528→		// Display all interactions in this checkpoint
   529→		for i, inter := range cp.Interactions {
   530→			// For multiple interactions, add a sub-header
   531→			if len(cp.Interactions) > 1 {
   532→				sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("### Interaction %d\n\n", i+1))
   533→			}
   534→
   535→			// Prompt section
   536→			if inter.Prompt != "" {
   537→				sb.WriteString("## Prompt\n\n")
   538→				sb.WriteString(inter.Prompt)
   539→				sb.WriteString("\n\n")
   540→			}
   541→
   542→			// Response section
   543→			if len(inter.Responses) > 0 {
   544→				sb.WriteString("## Responses\n\n")
   545→				sb.WriteString(strings.Join(inter.Responses, "\n\n"))
   546→				sb.WriteString("\n\n")
   547→			}
   548→
   549→			// Files modified for this interaction
   550→			if len(inter.Files) > 0 {
   551→				sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Files Modified (%d):\n", len(inter.Files)))
   552→				for _, file := range inter.Files {
   553→					sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  - %s\n", file))
   554→				}
   555→				sb.WriteString("\n")
   556→			}
   557→		}
   558→
   559→		// If no interactions, show message and/or files
   560→		if len(cp.Interactions) == 0 {
   561→			// Show commit message as summary when no transcript available
   562→			if cp.Message != "" {
   563→				sb.WriteString(cp.Message)
   564→				sb.WriteString("\n\n")
   565→			}
   566→			// Show aggregate files if available
   567→			if len(cp.Files) > 0 {
   568→				sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Files Modified (%d):\n", len(cp.Files)))
   569→				for _, file := range cp.Files {
   570→					sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  - %s\n", file))
   571→				}
   572→			}
   573→		}
   574→	}
   575→
   576→	return sb.String()
   577→}

   579→// formatCommitInfo formats commit information for display.
   580→func formatCommitInfo(info *commitInfo) string {
   581→	var sb strings.Builder
   582→
   583→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Commit: %s (%s)\n", info.SHA, info.ShortSHA))
   584→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Date: %s\n", info.Date.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")))
   585→
   586→	if info.HasEntire && info.SessionID != "" {
   587→		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Session: %s\n", info.SessionID))
   588→	}
   589→
   590→	sb.WriteString("\n")
   591→
   592→	// Message
   593→	sb.WriteString("Message:\n")
   594→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %s\n", info.Message))
   595→	sb.WriteString("\n")
   596→
   597→	// Files modified
   598→	if len(info.Files) > 0 {

   617→	if f, ok := w.(*os.File); ok && f == os.Stdout && term.IsTerminal(int(f.Fd())) {

   636→			cmd.Stdout = f
   637→			cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr

   639→			if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {

   642→			}
